<!DOCTYPE html><html  lang="en-us" data-font-mode="brand"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, minimum-scale=1, user-scalable=no"><title>Silver Palace - Where shadows whisper, traces never lie</title><script id="initial-rem">(function () {
  var ua = navigator.userAgent;
  var mobileRegex = /Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i;
  var isMobile = mobileRegex.test(ua) || window.innerWidth < 768;

  var PC_BASE_WIDTH = 2560;
  var PC_BASE_HEIGHT = 1392;
  var MOBILE_BASE_WIDTH = 1179;
  var MOBILE_BASE_HEIGHT = 2556;
  var BASE_REM = 100;

  function setRootFontSize() {
    var rem;
    if (isMobile) {
      var widthScale = window.innerWidth / MOBILE_BASE_WIDTH;
      var heightScale = window.innerHeight / MOBILE_BASE_HEIGHT;
      if (window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight < 1179 / 2556) {
        rem = heightScale * BASE_REM
      } else if (window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight > 750 / 1400) {
        rem = heightScale * BASE_REM * 1.15;
      } else {
        rem = widthScale * BASE_REM
      }
    } else {
      var widthScale = window.innerWidth / PC_BASE_WIDTH;
      var heightScale = window.innerHeight / PC_BASE_HEIGHT;
      rem = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight > 16 / 9
        ? heightScale * BASE_REM
        : widthScale * BASE_REM;
    }
    document.documentElement.style.fontSize = rem + 'px';
    // 与 rem.client.ts defaultStrategy 一致，始终写入 --home-fs
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--home-fs', rem + 'px');
    // 首屏脚本只用 defaultStrategy，比值先为 1；entrance 等页由 rem.client.ts 覆盖
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--home-rem-ratio', '1');
  }

  setRootFontSize();
